We do not believe that the above statement is an entirely valid one. Natural resources, such as cultivated crops and forest products, become partially irretrievable when they are not harvested. Not harvesting a useable crop or product can be considered a wasteful practice or loss of an irretrievable natural resource, both to man and/or a wildlife species. For example, it has been shown that by not harvesting timber from a forested watershed the hydrologic condition of the watershed has deteriorated.
We appreciate the opportunity to review and comment on the subject draft environmental statement.
Roman H. Koenings
